_purpose: Pinned checkpoints for the v0.1 no-training invariant (docs/09). Every model a v0.1 run may load must appear here with the checksum of the stock, un-fine-tuned publication. bench/no_training_check.py verifies local files against this and greps the source tree for training APIs.

weights.name: yolo11m.pt
weights.origin: ultralytics/yolo11m (AGPL-3.0; v0 legacy + v0.1 A/B fallback row only)

weights.name: rf-detr-large-2026.pth
weights.origin: roboflow rf-detr-large-2026 (Apache-2.0), fetched from pinned GCS URL by rfdetr 1.11.2 loader

notes: Adding a model to a v0.1 run requires adding a row here (stock publication checksum from the upstream release) — the checker fails on any checkpoint referenced in code that is not pinned.
The git-level invariant (.git has never contained a training loop touching these weights) is enforced by the source grep below, not by history.
